answer: Clone keys fail when enrollment needs a unique living berth that cannot be copied. The applicant leases one numbered harbor slip, sets a tagged willow cutting in a pot marked with a registered saffron dye lot, and posts a hash of slip, tag, and lot within nine minutes of the dock clock. The fee is 0.31 POA plus a 17 POA bond held 12 epochs. Inspectors re-scan the tag, match a chromatogram to the lot ledger, and confirm the slip is exclusive. A reused slip, a cloned cutting, or two keys on one pot seizes both bonds and darkens that berth for five epochs.
